blocks.text: **Outside the scope of this report.** This chapter previews the Phase 2 (autonomy) parts of the model, so that an engineer new to the project knows that they exist and how they are switched on. Phase 2 is not demonstrated or accepted in this report. Every Phase 1 result in this report was produced with `VC_PHASE = 1`. In that configuration the companion computer is replaced by `GNC_Stub`, which sends no COMP_CMD frames, so AUTO can never be armed.

Phase 2 adds a companion computer. It localises the robot, detects obstacles and runs missions autonomously. It drives the robot through the same MCU, ESC, drive and power chain that Phase 1 demonstrates. {fig:F18_architecture.png} shows this companion block greyed out. The build scripts generate the Phase 2 models in the same way as the rest of the project. `Shaddad_System` compiles with `VC_PHASE = 2` with 0 algebraic loops (`AlgebraicLoopMsg = error`), and the S4 and S5 runs after the fix pass of 2026-10-23 use this configuration. In the acceptance run before the fix pass, the update took 61.9 s in a fresh MATLAB session.

blocks.text: The sensor plant models these sensors:

items: **IMU**, ICM-20948 class, 200 Hz: `mspsensorlib/IMU` with lever arm, vibration and DLPF.
**GNSS**, dual-antenna RTK, ZED-F9P class, 10 Hz: three `mspsensorlib/GPS` noise sets, a fix-state chain driven by sky view, and 80 ms latency.
**LiDAR**, Ouster OS1-32 class, 10 Hz: `VC_LIDAR = 1` selects FAST2D ray casting, and `VC_LIDAR = 2` selects FULL3D with the UAV Scenario Lidar.

blocks.text: The sensor plant is also active in Phase 1. The IMU feeds the MCU yaw-rate loop and tilt monitor. The GNSS and LiDAR outputs end at the terminators inside `GNC_Stub`.

The EKF runs on the companion at 0.01 s. It has 11 states: East/North/Up position, yaw, forward speed, lateral skid velocity, gyro yaw-rate bias, accelerometer bias, left and right track slip, and the effective track-gauge factor chi. The filter is a MATLAB System block (`subsystems/sensors/sens_nav_ekf.m`) that wraps the toolbox `extendedKalmanFilter`. The library EKF block was not used, because a Resettable Subsystem does not re-initialise its Data Store Memory. `sens_nav_gate` gates each correction with a chi-square test (p = 0.999). After repeated rejections, it force-accepts the measurement with an inflated R.
{tab:tab_p2_ekf} lists the measurement channels of the EKF and the rate at which each correction is applied.

rows: Heading from the dual antenna (ecompass at standstill for initialisation)

blocks.text: The mode manager `sens_nav_mode` has the states INIT, ALIGN, RUN_GNSS, RUN_LIDAR, DEAD_RECKONING and FAULT. RUN_LIDAR is used in the greenhouse, or when a prior map exists and there is no RTK fix. The manager declares the filter aligned when the position sigma is below 0.15 m and the yaw sigma is below 2°. It drops `navValid` after 10 s without an accepted absolute update.

items: **Mission compiler** `scripts/gnc_compileMission.m` (runs offline). It turns a JSON field map from `scripts/missions/` (`greenhouse_std`, `palm_demo`, `solar_demo`) into `Bus_MissionPlan`. Coverage lanes come from `uavCoverageSpace` and `uavCoveragePlanner`. The compiler adds skip-row ordering, Dubins headland turns (`dubinsConnection`), transits and a dock approach. The plan is stored in `P.gnc.mission`, and a Constant block inside `Shaddad_GNC` reads it.
**Path serving.** Two Path Smoother Spline blocks and a Velocity Profiler prepare each segment. `gnc_pathAnalyzer` computes the cross-track error, heading error and progress.

**Trackers.** Pure Pursuit handles transit, headland turns, return-to-home and rejoin. On rows the tracker is Adaptive MPC (`VC_ROW_TRACKER = 1`, the default, with object `mpcRowObj` from `scripts/gnc_designMPC.m`) or Stanley (`VC_ROW_TRACKER = 2`). A pivot ALIGN law runs when the heading error exceeds 45°.

**Speed governor and command shaping.** The speed command is the minimum of the profile and the curvature, obstacle, tracking-error, tilt, navigation-accuracy, SOC and mode limits. It is rate-limited to 0.5 m/s² acceleration and 1.0 m/s² deceleration. The output stays inside the track-speed envelope |v| + |omega| chi B/2 ≤ 2.0 m/s and the MCU AUTO limits (1.5 m/s forward, 0.5 m/s reverse, 1.2 rad/s).

**Obstacle handling.** OBSTACLE_HOLD is entered when the path-tube corridor (0.1 s) sees an obstacle closer than 1.5 m, when the Vector Field Histogram finds no free direction for 0.2 s, or when Perception sets `person_near` (protective field). If the robot was on a row and the segment allows a bypass, it starts one after 10 s in HOLD: a local Hybrid A* detour, followed by a Timed Elastic Band (`VC_TEB = 1`) or VFH-steered pursuit (`VC_TEB = 0`). Hybrid A* (`gnc_globalReplanner`, triggered, 1 s rate) also plans the return-to-home and rejoin paths.

**Mission manager** `gnc_missionFSM`. It is a MATLAB Function, because Stateflow is not installed. Its states are IDLE, MANUAL, AUTO_MISSION, PAUSE, OBSTACLE_HOLD, RETURN_TO_HOME and FAULT. The AUTO sub-modes are ALIGN, TRANSIT, ROW, TURN, BYPASS, REJOIN, RTH_PLANNING, RTH_TRANSIT, DOCK_APPROACH and DOCKED. The manager also supervises navigation integrity, the geofence, tilt and stuck detection, and starts the SOC-based return to the dock.
**Implement manager.** It sets mower, tiller and sprayer commands from the segment type and mode. Spray flow is proportional to speed.

blocks.text: Autonomous driving needs three things: the Phase 2 variant, a compiled mission, and a two-sided handshake between the MCU and the GNC (decision D20). The handshake keeps the MCU in charge.

items: **Variant.** `VC_PHASE = 2` selects the `Companion` choice of `GNC_Variant` (Model block `Shaddad_Companion`) in place of `GNC_Stub`. The Phase 2 scenarios set this variable themselves through `SimulationInput` and leave the base workspace unchanged.
**Mission.** `scn_auto_setup` compiles the mission with `gnc_compileMission`, assigns it to `P.gnc.mission`, designs `mpcRowObj` and places the robot at the mission home pose.

**MCU side.** With CH5 in AUTO (`sw_mode` 3) and an arm edge, the MCU goes from STANDBY to AUTO_START. This needs a valid RC link, the arm request, BMS `HV_Ready`, DI SAFETY_OK, fresh companion frames (`comp_ok`), `gnc_ready` (navigation OK, plan valid, no GNC fault), no class-B fault and the lid closed. AUTO_START sounds a 3 s buzzer warning and then enters AUTO.

**drive_ready.** The MCU sets `Bus_McuStatus.drive_ready` when it is in AUTO, both ESCs are ready and HV is ready, and sends it to the companion in MCU_STATUS (CAN-FD). This signal was never true until the fix of 2026-10-23 wired `Mode_Manager` to `Is_auto` in `build_shaddad_mcu.m`.

**GNC side.** On mission command START (CH13, the dashboard or the scenario table), the mission manager goes from IDLE to AUTO_MISSION. The conditions are RC in AUTO, `nav_ok`, a valid plan, SOC > 0.35 and `drive_ready`. The GNC then sets `cmd_valid`, and the MCU follows COMP_CMD.

blocks.text: The MCU remains the final mode authority in AUTO. CH5 MANUAL, stick override, the CH12 remote E-stop and every supervisor fault win over GNC commands. RC link loss gives a class-B controlled stop, because `rc_required_in_auto = true`. A companion timeout of 0.20 s gives CTRL_STOP. The hardware E-stop chain works independently of all software.

{tab:tab_p2_status} summarises the Phase 2 runs in Normal mode. S5 and S4 were run after the fix pass of 2026-10-23. The S7 figures come from the acceptance probe, which had the two motion fixes applied in memory. `docs/STATUS.md` records no S7 result after the fix pass.

items: **S5.** The route time is 1.06 x nominal. The bypass fails three criteria: box clearance 0.40 m (needs ≥ 0.5 m), braking starts 6.1 s after the box enters the corridor (needs ≤ 0.5 s), and the rejoin takes 6.2 m (needs ≤ 3 m). The pedestrian never came closer than 32.7 m, so its timing in the scenario needs retuning.

**S4.** The mission manager reaches AUTO_MISSION. At the greenhouse entrance the `person_near` trigger of OBSTACLE_HOLD fires, and the manager then toggles between HOLD and AUTO. The cause is the protective field, which fires on static walls; it needs static-map masking or a footprint-aware field. Scan matching accepts 89.8 % of the scans.

**S7farm.** The GNSS outage starts at 20 s, and the robot pauses about 4 s later and never resumes. The navigation results inside the outage pass: position error 0.10 m, heading error 0.68° and XTE 0.025 m. Two navigation criteria fail, because the covariance is optimistic: NEES in bound 78.7 % (needs ≥ 90 %), and the position error 5 s after RTK returns is 0.238 m (needs < 0.05 m). The navigation-degraded pause policy also needs rework, because S7 requires driving through the outage on dead reckoning.

blocks.text: Other open Phase 2 items: the MPC row tracker shows yaw oscillation (2.15° RMS against 1.5°) and pass overlap (23 % against 15 %). The `mspsensorlib` IMU System object cannot save SimState, so long missions cannot restart from an operating point. Long missions are also slow on this PC (Normal-mode RTF about 0.1-0.45), because Windows Application Control blocks the Accelerator MEX files. Companion code generation and ROS 2 deployment remain BLOCKED until Simulink Coder is installed.
